assertions: The pinned production repository keeps Session history, current work, durable knowledge and query-time model context as separate boundaries.
A real production Personal Knowledge Base projects current work, one relevant prior Session excerpt and matching durable Markdown from an isolated repository.
The current Session is excluded from prior-session source references, and disabling prior Sessions returns no session:* source.
The public projection stays within the caller character budget and contains only logical .pkb/current.md, session:* or knowledge/*.md references.
Real cwd, Git revision, provider fields and raw transcript are not exposed or retained.
Reading context does not mutate Session history or durable knowledge and never authorizes execution.
